title: 20-Unit Apartment Building Demolition
description: Blue Rock Remodeling takes a 20-unit apartment building in Maryland down to ground level. Permitting took three months; the demolition itself took two and a half weeks.

title: Second Story Over the Garage: Interior Walkthrough
description: A walkthrough of the second story Blue Rock built over an attached two-car garage in Bethesda, MD, from the original exterior to the finished upper level.

title: Mid-Century Second Story: Interior Walkthrough
description: A walkthrough of the mid-century second story Blue Rock added above a split-level's garage wing in Rockville, MD, showing the finished interior.
